LESSON: PHYSICAL

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.1: Physical

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Physical. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. recognise the Holy Bible as the word of God by naming the first two Gospel books
2. appreciate the Holy Bible by stating its two divisions that is, the Old and the New Testament

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. recognise the Holy Bible as the word of God by naming the first two Gospel books
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to recognise the Holy Bible as the word of God by naming the first two Gospel books. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. appreciate the Holy Bible by stating its two divisions that is, the Old and the New Testament
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the Holy Bible by stating its two divisions that is, the Old and the New Testament. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Physical.
2. Explain Physical to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Physical.
4. Show that you can: recognise the Holy Bible as the word of God by naming the first two Gospel books
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Physical. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Physical important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. recognise the Holy Bible as the word of God by naming the first two Gospel books
2. appreciate the Holy Bible by stating its two divisions that is, the Old and the New Testament

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
